_about: What each training graphic is, written by hand from looking at every post in the Drive folder. Keys match the post names. 'template' is the engine template that reproduces the layout. Add an entry when you add a post; posts without one are classified by Claude during training if an API key is set (train --annotate), otherwise left 'unknown'. Set 'use_as_example': false to keep a post out of the examples Claude sees (its measurements still count).

Post 1.graphic_notes: Screenshot of someone else's viral social post on a dark background, with a thick red rectangle drawn around the first letter of every line to expose the joke. Proof-style image; the caption carries the lesson.

Post 2.graphic_notes: Screenshot of a course catalogue page with two black rounded sticker captions in heavy condensed white caps across the middle: a short shout, then the headline claim.
Post 2.content_warning: The text tells readers to have another AI complete course quizzes for them. The engine must never teach cheating on courses or certifications.

Thin mono footer line with the newsletter.
